latest.title: Non-time-decaying global classical solutions to nonlinear wave equations in 3D under the null condition
latest.abstract: We present an alternative proof of the global well-posedness of nonlinear wave equations in three spatial dimensions under the null condition, in the regularity regime of the classical local existence theory, assuming smallness of the angular derivatives. Unlike previous methods, which rely on decay in time, our approach is based solely on spatial decay. This provides a new perspective on the problem and offers potential applications to the study of Einstein's equations, which we intend to explore in future work.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究球面上的角向 Littlewood–Paley 分解和 null-form 波方程估计，控制径向与角向频率交互。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 1.1 给出主角向频率估计，用于具有 null condition 的波方程非线性控制。
latest.limitations: 依赖球面角向结构、频率局部化和 null condition；估计针对文中波方程函数空间。

steps.claim: Proposition 2.1 证明径向投影与频率算子相容。
steps.route: 利用球面旋转对称性，验证 $R\nu $ 与 Littlewood–Paley/角向投影交换，为分频估计提供代数基础。

steps.claim: Lemmas 2.2–2.3 控制 null-form 与 dyadic commutator。
steps.route: 将仿射二次型写成切向/径向分量并利用 null condition 消除最坏相互作用，再用频率支撑估计交换子。

steps.claim: Theorem 1.1 由角向分解和多线性求和闭合。
steps.route: 对每个 dyadic/角向块应用前述估计，按频率序列求和并结合球面 Sobolev 嵌入，得到主范数界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第3–5页，第1节 Theorem 1.1；后续主估计章节。
